description: Authorize one more player (by public IP) on an existing relay session, for a player joining after the session was created. Returns that player's authorization token.

dry_run.description: Show the exact request (method, host, path, body) with secrets masked, and send nothing. Local checks still run. Use it to confirm a billable or destructive call before making it.

user_ip.description: Public IP of the joining player.

name: edgegap_authorize_relay_user
title: Add a player to a relay session
